usdc.description: USDC amount as a decimal string, up to 6 decimals.

amount.description: Token amount as a decimal string.

request_id.description: Any new id per request; repeat it to retry safely.

confirm.description: One-time code from the card; never shown to the model.

confirm_meta.description: Result _meta "yeet/confirm": read by the card only.

parts.description: Whole parts, 0-99. A coin's share is its parts divided by the basket's total parts (6 and 4 = 60% and 40%; 3, 1 and 1 = 60%, 20% and 20%). 0 leaves the coin out; at least one coin needs 1 or more.

amount_in.description: What this leg spends: USDC for yeet, the coin for skeet.

min_leg_usdc.description: Minimum USDC each coin in a YEET basket must get (the card warns before a coin goes under it).

fund_url.description: With BALANCE_LOW: where the person adds USDC. The card shows an Add funds button that opens it.

attempt_id.description: One sign attempt of one trade leg.

send_status.description: awaiting_signature: the person has not signed yet; signing: signed and on its way; awaiting_gas: signed, network fee on its way; sent: on chain; failed and not_sent: nothing moved.

solana_tx_payload.description: A Solana transaction for the person to sign as its second signer. YEET pays the network fee as the first signer.

evm_tx_payload.description: An EIP-1559 transaction for the person to sign (sign only, never send). Integers above 2^53 are decimal strings.

sign_request.description: What the person's own wallet signs for one trade leg. Sign it with the wallet named in `wallet`, sign only, never broadcast.

limits.description: BUY caps of the person's XP tier, per trade and per UTC day. Sells are never capped.

spin_reason.description: Why an extra spin was granted.

wheel_slice.description: One wheel slice: a tradable coin and the bonus XP value shown on it (base_xp is paid on top).

lucky_id.description: Id of one lucky wheel (one per account and UTC day).

lucky.description: The lucky wheel: the server’s hottest coins today; YEET amount_usdc into the landed coin for one bonus daily spin and a stamp of that coin.

slice.description: Index into wheel where the spin landed; null before the spin.

claimed.description: True once a settled YEET of at least amount_usdc into the landed coin granted the bonus spin.

stamp_count.description: Stamps of one coin: the card being filled now is floor(count/7)+1 with progress count % 7.

guidance.description: Text for the assistant about this result; the card does not read it.

yeet_home.title: YEET home
yeet_home.description: Shows whether the person's YEET account is ready to trade, their USDC and their XP.

fund_url.description: Where the person adds USDC on Base. The card opens it from its Add funds button while ready is needs_funds.

next_streak_milestone.description: The next streak length that pays a streak bonus and its fixed XP (the bonus draw comes on top); null when none is left.

wheel.description: The slices the next daily_spin returns today, before the spin (the landing slice is not marked).

yeet_coins.title: YEET coins
yeet_coins.description: Lists every tradable coin with its USD price, its percent change over 1, 6 and 24 hours, and the trade limits.

yeet_propose.title: Quote a YEET basket
yeet_propose.description: Quotes a YEET (buy) basket that spends USDC on 1-5 coins split by whole-number parts and shows the basket card; it buys nothing.

lucky_id.description: Optional: the lucky wheel this YEET is for. Set it when proposing the coin the lucky wheel landed on.

yeet_quote.title: Refresh a YEET quote
yeet_quote.description: Refreshes an existing YEET or SKEET quote by proposal_id and saves it as a new revision; it trades nothing.

execute_trade.title: Run a confirmed trade
execute_trade.description: Starts a quoted basket from the card. Only the card can call this; it needs the one-time code the card holds. Answers one sign request per coin, which the person’s own wallet signs in the card.

submit_trade_signature.title: Send a signed trade transfer
submit_trade_signature.description: Takes the transfer the person's own wallet signed for one coin of a trade. Only the card calls this, once per sign request; YEET checks it, adds the network fee and sends it.

signed.description: The signed transaction: base64 (Solana) or 0x02 hex (Base).

trade_status.title: Trade status
trade_status.description: Returns the live status of a trade and what was received.

yeet_portfolio.title: YEET portfolio
yeet_portfolio.description: Shows the coins and USDC the person holds on YEET, with values.

skeet_propose.title: Quote a SKEET
skeet_propose.description: Quotes a SKEET (sell) of a percent of 1-5 held coins back to USDC and shows the SKEET card; it sells nothing.

yeet_leaderboard.title: YEET leaderboard
yeet_leaderboard.description: Shows a YEET leaderboard (xp, winners, best_trade, losers or coins) for a time window, with the person's place.

daily_spin.title: Daily XP spin
daily_spin.description: Card only: uses the next available daily or bonus spin and awards its XP and stamp.

wheel.description: One slice per coin, catalog order; every slice shows a different value.

slice.description: Index into wheel where the spin lands; wheel[slice].xp equals draw_xp.

set_bonus_xp.description: XP paid for completing a set with this stamp; not part of xp_won, included in total.

spins_available.description: Spins left today after this one.

yeet_set_username.title: Set YEET username
yeet_set_username.description: Replaces the person's YEET display name.

lucky_wheel.title: Lucky wheel
lucky_wheel.description: Shows today's lucky wheel card: up to five randomly picked coins and the YEET offer for the coin it lands on.

lucky_spin.title: Spin the lucky wheel
lucky_spin.description: Spin today’s lucky wheel. Only the card calls this; one spin per wheel, and a repeat returns the same coin.

home.title: YEET home
home.description: Wallet readiness, USDC balance, XP, streak and the daily spin.

basket.title: YEET basket
basket.description: A quoted basket: coins with their parts, each coin's share in percent and USDC, an amount slider, estimated amounts, cost, and the YEET or SKEET button.

receipt.title: YEET receipt
receipt.description: Live status of a trade per coin, amounts received, explorer links and a share picture once it is done.

portfolio.title: YEET portfolio
portfolio.description: Coins and USDC in the YEET wallets, each coin with a YEET more button and a SKEET button, and a share picture.

leaderboard.title: YEET leaderboard
leaderboard.description: XP ranks and your place on the board.

x-yeet-spin.parts: xp_won = base_xp + draw_xp + streak_xp; draw_xp is one bonus_xp value; streak_xp is 0, or on a streak milestone streak_bonus_xp plus a second, independent bonus_xp draw

x-yeet-scopes.yeet:read: See wallets, coins, trades and XP.
x-yeet-scopes.yeet:trade: Send USDC or coins from the YEET wallet, only after a tap in the card.

INVALID_ARGUMENT.title: Check the request
INVALID_ARGUMENT.message: A value in the request is not valid, so check the coins, parts and amount.

COIN_NOT_SUPPORTED.title: Coin not available
COIN_NOT_SUPPORTED.message: One of these coins can’t be traded on YEET right now, so pick another from the coin list.

PARTS_EMPTY.title: Pick at least one coin
PARTS_EMPTY.message: Every coin is at 0 parts, so give at least one coin 1 or more parts.

AMOUNT_TOO_SMALL.title: A coin gets too little
AMOUNT_TOO_SMALL.message: Each coin needs at least the minimum per coin (3 USDC), so raise the amount, give the smallest coin more parts or set it to 0.

COST_TOO_HIGH.title: Fees too high right now
COST_TOO_HIGH.message: Swap costs for this basket are above the YEET limit, so try a larger amount or fewer coins.

LIMIT_EXCEEDED.title: Over your limit
LIMIT_EXCEEDED.message: This trade would go over the per-trade or daily USDC limit.

BALANCE_LOW.title: Not enough funds
BALANCE_LOW.message: Your YEET wallet doesn’t hold enough for this trade, so add funds or lower the amount.

WALLET_NOT_READY.title: Wallet not ready
WALLET_NOT_READY.message: Your YEET wallet isn’t set up for trading yet, so finish sign-in and try again.

CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED.title: Quote expired
CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED.message: That quote is old. Refresh it and try again.

REQUOTE_REQUIRED.title: Price moved
REQUOTE_REQUIRED.message: The price moved past your minimum, so refresh the quote to see the new numbers.

TRADING_PAUSED.title: Trading is paused
TRADING_PAUSED.message: YEET has paused trading for now and your funds stay in your wallet.

REAUTH_REQUIRED.title: Reconnect YEET
REAUTH_REQUIRED.message: ChatGPT needs your permission again, so reconnect YEET when it asks.

TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE.title: Try again in a minute
TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE.message: YEET couldn’t reach a service it needs and nothing was traded.

USERNAME_TAKEN.title: Username taken
USERNAME_TAKEN.message: That username is taken, so pick another one.

USERNAME_NOT_ALLOWED.title: Username reserved
USERNAME_NOT_ALLOWED.message: That username is reserved, so pick another one.
